run_serving_scores: run the ServingScores class to serve scoring and reranking requests for a vLLM pooling model
build_score_response: build a JSONResponse from pooling request outputs for a ScoreRequest with per-document scores
build_rerank_response: build a JSONResponse from pooling request outputs for a RerankRequest with ranked documents and top_n filtering
run_flash_late_interaction: run flash late interaction encoding to accelerate late-interaction scoring on GPU workers
encode_flash_queries: encode query embeddings in flash late interaction and cache token embeddings on workers
encode_flash_docs: encode document embeddings in flash late interaction and return scalar scores from workers
